english.title: Holder of London PHV driver's licence fail to return it within 7 days - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been the holder of a London private hire vehicle driver's licence, failed to return that licence and your driver's badge to the Secretary of State within the period of seven days after the day on which the

(A)_[licence expired]_
(B)_[revocation of the licence took effect]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22(3), (5) and (6) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

In the case of a continuing offence, to a fine not exceeding ten pounds for each day during which an offence continues after conviction.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
